channel.title: The Journal · Patrick Stolinski
channel.description: Notes from the field: PROTO Robotics, the Hult Prize US Nationals, the Raikes Startup Studio, and more from Patrick Stolinski.

item.title: PROTO Robotics: making real engineering feel like an adventure
item.description: PROTO Robotics is a robotics-education company on a mission to make real engineering feel like an adventure for elementary-age kids. We design and build the entire experience in-house: a LEGO-compatible robotics kit powered by our own custom RP2040-based controller board, a story-driven curriculum with hands-on missions that carry students from block coding to real Python, and a self-hosted learning platform where any device can program the robot.

item.title: Hult Prize US Nationals: fresh perspective in the desert
item.description: Sometimes it takes a trip somewhere new to provide fresh perspective. My trip to Tucson, AZ with the PROTO Robotics team did just that.

item.title: Student Entrepreneur Award, UNL Center for Entrepreneurship
item.description: Honored to be named the UNL Center for Entrepreneurship's Student Entrepreneur of the year, recognized as a robotics engineering major building PROTO within the University of Nebraska-Lincoln College of Engineering.

item.title: PROTO joins Raikes Startup Studio, with $100K from Invest Nebraska
item.description: New opportunities are on the horizon, and I couldn't be more proud to share the news: PROTO Robotics has officially earned a spot in the Jeffrey S. Raikes School of Computer Science and Management's Startup Studio Program for the 2026-27 school year, and received a $100K investment from Invest Nebraska.

item.title: The Innovative Learning Conference at The Nueva School
item.description: I had the opportunity to attend the 2026 Innovative Learning Conference at The Nueva School in San Francisco, made possible through the Nebraska Center for Entrepreneurship. I can't overstate how much I took away from this experience, hearing from and connecting with Kevin Lynch (VP of Technology, Apple), Chris Cox (CPO, Meta), Fei-Fei Li (Stanford Human-Centered AI Institute), Samira Rahmatullah (Visa), Andrew Hall (Stanford GSB), and educators from across the country.
